name: Colored_Background_OCSR_benchmark
description:
Dataset Card for Alpha-Extractor OCSR Benchmark
	

This dataset is a small, challenging benchmark for Optical Chemical Structure Recognition (OCSR), featuring 200 images. The data is a subset of the test data created for the "αExtractor" system, a tool specifically designed to perform well on difficult images, including those with backgrounds, low quality, and even hand-drawn structures. It serves as an excellent test of model robustness.

	
		
	
	
		Dataset Details… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/hheiden/Colored_Background_OCSR_benchmark.
evaluation_method: exact_match (SMILES/string match) and molecular equivalence checks
general_score_metric: exact match rate (SMILES or canonical representation)
reputation: A small, specialized robustness benchmark used by the OCSR community to test difficult/realistic chemical structure images; limited but respected within that niche.
